driveMessage: 🦃 The 2026 Lucketts Turkey Drive kicks off Monday, October 19! Join our community as we work together to provide Thanksgiving turkeys to local families in need. Just $10 feeds one family, and our goal is to help at least 200 families this Thanksgiving!
preLaunchMessage: The 2026 Lucketts Turkey Drive kicks off Monday, October 19!
postDriveMessage: Thank you, Lucketts! Together we made Thanksgiving brighter for local families.

reachGoals.message: 🎉 Goal reached! The Principal will dress up as a TURKEY!
